_meta.scope: open-source doctor · ALEXA AEO buyer-question bank (real shopper voice, not keywords)
_meta.purpose: ALEXA AEO（Answer Engine Optimization）：模拟真实买家向 AI 购物助手（Alexa for Shopping / Rufus）提问，判断 listing 能否被回答/推荐。本文件是问题池——按类目取，缺类目 fallback _common。
_meta.design: aspect×starter 模板 + Buyer Alignment 三态评分（covered/partial/missing）。问句是完整口语问句，不是关键词；每个问题模拟一个真实购物决策疑虑。
aspect_taxonomy: audience_fit: Is this good for {audience} / Will this fit a {audience}?
durability: Will this last / Is this {limitation}?
comparison: How does this compare to {brand}?
cost: Is this worth the price?
